spans.s: नुत, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, commended.

1. नूत, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, eulogized, lauded,
hymned.
2. नूत, अस्, आ, अम्, = नुत्त or नुन्न.

नुत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, pushed away, despatched, sent,
ordered; (अस्), m. a plant, see लकुच.

नुति, इस्, f. praise, laudation, eulogium, panegyric;
worship, reverence.
नुत्ति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. 1. नुद्), repelling, removal.

नूतन नूतन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. नु and con-
nected with 1. नव, q. v.), new, novel, recent, modern,
fresh, young, (opposed to पूर्व, पुराण, &c.);
[]
present; instantaneous, sudden; curious, strange.
—नूतन-ता, f. or नूतन-त्व, अम्, n. newness,
novelty.

नूतनय, Nom. P. नूतनयति, &c., to make
new, renew.

नूत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, new, fresh, young, recent.
—नूत्न-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, in the bloom of youth,
in the spring of life.
